messages:
maya_cs: Heads-up from Acadia procurement — they flagged our vendor form: embedding retention for tenant data with direct identifiers is a non-negotiable. They put onboarding on hold.

raj_se: Do we have their exact requirement?

maya_cs: Quote from their sec team: 
```
Requirement: Ability to opt out of persistent storage of embeddings generated from any content containing direct identifiers (SSN, bank account numbers, driver license). Proof of enforcement required.
```

lina_legal: We can do a DPA addendum referencing a technical control and provide a short SOC2-style attestation. Need engineering confirmation on what control we can ship fast.

nate_prod: Product question: do we expose per-tenant toggles or only via contract/Account Ops? Also do we allow scrub-on-ingest instead?

raj_se: Fastest technical stop-gap = API opt-out param that prevents persistence + audit logging. Example param: {"retain_embeddings": false}. Server returns ephemeral vectors and logs the event. Can be feature-flagged.

maya_cs: Customer wants something to point to within 10 business days or they won't approve.

lina_legal: Legal will draft the addendum and a one-page attestation if eng confirms timeline.

raj_se: Confirmed: prototype opt-out + audit trail doable in ~10 business days if we prioritize. Full solution later: tenant-keyed stores + retention policies with KMS.

onboard-bot: Ticket ONB-2291 updated: status = blocked (embedding retention). ETA 10 business days.

maya_cs: Thanks — I'll tell Acadia we have a mitigation plan and legal draft + ETA. Please post PRD link and any blockers in this thread. :thumbsup:
